label: Prototype — SIMULATED data — AI signal, not a diagnosis

transcript: 07:09 — Wakes up. Gets up right away.
07:30 — Breakfast with the crew. Kelly: “I feel like I'm going around in circles here.” Low, monotone voice.
08:30 — Briefing with Earth (delayed message). Kelly asks two questions about the schedule and suggests a change.
10:00 — Air filtration system maintenance: abandoned midway, postponed to tomorrow. Kelly: “We'll see anyway.”
12:40 — Eats alone in his cabin, ration half eaten.
14:00 — Exercise session: cut short at 25 of 60 min. Says he has a headache.
16:00 — Biology experiment with Okafor. Kelly forgets a step; Okafor redoes it without comment.
17:30 — Free time alone in his cabin, door closed. Looks at photos of Earth for 40 min without moving.
19:30 — Shared dinner. Kelly: “I'm tired, that's all.” Stays apart at the back of the module.
21:00 — Movie night with the crew, comments on the film.

hypotheses.schema: Social withdrawal settling in over several days: less speech and meals eaten alone, without a complete break with the crew.
preuves: Speaking time at 26 min today (-46%) and 10 min on D93 (-79%), with a deviation of at least 20% for 7 consecutive days (D88 to D94).
Meal eaten alone in his cabin at 12:40 and withdrawal to the back of the module at the 19:30 dinner (actions and speech observers).
Time with the crew at 147 min, i.e. -18%: a real drop but below the 20% threshold.

preuves: Said in a low voice at breakfast: “I feel like I'm going around in circles here.”

Self-reported mood at 3/5 today (-21%) and at 2/5 from D89 to D92, i.e. 2 indicators out of range over several days.

hypotheses.schema: Physical fatigue and slowing down, possibly linked to poorer recovery, to be reviewed with the body data.
preuves: HRV at 38.6 ms today (-32%) and 42.4 ms on the 7-day average (-25%).

output.noteAuPsy: The signal has lasted 7 days and is consistent across the observations, self-reported mood and low HRV. No one-off incident explains the drop, and cortisol was not measured today. A one-on-one conversation about the feeling of repetition and the workload seems appropriate.

output.noteAuPsy: The signal is persistent: reduced speaking time, skipped meals and low mood have recurred since D89, and all three observers describe it consistently. Cortisol from D91 (454 nmol/L) has no personal baseline provided, and no measurement is available for D94, so this point cannot be interpreted. An informal, non-evaluative conversation seems worth considering for Kelly, keeping in mind that this is a pattern to watch and not a diagnosis.
